$comment: Generated by scripts/build.py from tutorials/tutorials.json. Each guide answers one question with a short narrated video; link people to its url.
title: Magic Wand How To
scope: Control V2 on the native receiver
illustrated: Each video is an illustrated guide drawn from wand.json, not a recording of the real wand.

guides.question: How do I move the pointer and click?
questions: How do I use the wand as a mouse?
How do I click?
How do I turn on mouse follow?
How do I stop the pointer following the wand?
guides.summary: Tap Bottom to follow, stop to click once, tap again to stop.
narration: Tap Bottom once. The light turns blue and the pointer starts following the wand. Nothing is clicked.
Turn the wand to move the pointer.
Stop on what you want. After a brief pause, it clicks once.
Tap Bottom again to stop following, without a click.

controls.result: Click once after a 200 ms pause

guides.question: How do I drag something?
questions: How do I drag and drop?
How do I select text?
How do I move a window?
How do I hold the mouse button down?
guides.summary: Tap Bottom, then hold the second press to drag; release to drop.
narration: Tap Bottom, then press it again and keep holding. That holds the mouse button down.
Turn the wand to drag.
Release Bottom to drop.
A plain hold scrolls instead, so always tap first when you want to drag or select text.

controls.gesture: Tap, then hold the second press
controls.result: Drag with the mouse button down; release to drop

controls.note: A plain hold only scrolls, including over text. Tap, then hold the second press to drag. The pointer stays fixed while scrolling until release.

guides.question: How do I get the pointer back to the middle?
questions: I lost the pointer. How do I find it?
How do I centre the pointer?
How do I recenter the cursor?
Where did my pointer go?
guides.summary: Double tap Bottom to centre the pointer with mouse follow on.
narration: Lost the pointer? Double tap Bottom.
It jumps to the centre of your main screen, with mouse follow turned on.
The HUD, any review and dictation carry on as they were.

controls.result: Centre the pointer on the main screen and enable mouse follow; keep the HUD and review selection unchanged

guides.question: How do I scroll up and down?
questions: How do I scroll a page?
How do I scroll vertically?
How do I keep scrolling?
How do I scroll with circles?
guides.summary: Hold Bottom, move up or down, then keep circling; release to stop.
narration: Hold Bottom and move the wand up or down. That picks vertical scrolling, and the page follows the wand.
To keep going, carry on in circles. Your first loop can go either way round.
Reverse your circles to reverse the scrolling.
Release Bottom to stop. The pointer then follows the wand.

controls.result: Start left/right for horizontal or up/down for vertical, then continue in circles; reverse circling to reverse scrolling and release to stop

controls.note: V2 keeps the starting direction through either initial U-turn, even before circle recognition. Once circling is established, reversing it reverses scrolling without releasing. Standalone flick and circle triggers remain disabled; V1 retains its earlier gestures.
Release a completed scroll to enable mouse follow at the current pointer position, even if follow was off before scrolling.

guides.question: How do I scroll sideways?
questions: How do I scroll horizontally?
How do I scroll left and right?
How do I scroll a timeline?
guides.summary: Hold Bottom, start left or right, then keep circling; release to stop.
narration: Hold Bottom and start by moving left or right. That picks sideways scrolling.
Carry on in circles to keep scrolling the same way. It stays sideways until you let go.
Reverse the circles to scroll back, then release Bottom to stop.

controls.result: Start left/right for horizontal or up/down for vertical, then continue in circles; reverse circling to reverse scrolling and release to stop

controls.note: Hold Bottom and start left/right for horizontal scrolling, or up/down for vertical scrolling. Continue in circles on that axis; reverse winding to reverse scrolling. Release to stop and return to mouse follow.

guides.question: How do I open the HUD and use a card?
questions: How do I use the HUD?
How do I pick a HUD card?
How do I close the HUD?
What does the Middle button do?
guides.summary: Tap Middle, turn to a card, tap to use it; double tap to close.
narration: Tap Middle. The HUD opens on Switch App, and the light turns orange.
Turn the wand to move the outline. It stops at the edges.
Tap Middle again to use the outlined card. The HUD stays open.
Double tap Middle to close the HUD.
For a quick one-off, hold Middle, turn to a card and release to use it.

controls.result: Open the HUD on Switch App, then turn the wand to move the outline
Use the outlined card on release

controls.note: The outline stops at the edges instead of wrapping.

guides.question: How do I open a HUD page and go back?
questions: How do I open a HUD submenu?
How do I get to Keys mode?
How do I open Utility modes?
How do I use app-specific controls?
How do I go back in the HUD?
guides.summary: Tap Middle on a page card; its exit card goes back one page.
narration: Some cards open their own page, like Keys mode, Utility modes or controls for the current app.
Outline one and tap Middle to open its page.
The page's exit card takes you back one page.
Double tap Middle at any time to close the whole HUD.

guides.question: How do I switch apps?
questions: How do I go back to the last app?
How do I use Command-Tab?
How do I pick another app?
How do I use the app switcher?
guides.summary: Tap Switch App for your last app, or hold and turn to pick one.
narration: Tap Middle to open the HUD. It starts on Switch App.
Tap Middle again to jump back to the app you used last.
To pick a different app, hold Middle on Switch App and turn left or right through the app switcher. Release to switch.

controls.result: Open the HUD on Switch App, then turn the wand to move the outline
Hold the card; on some wheel cards, tilt to turn the wheel

guides.question: How do I dictate?
questions: How do I use speech to text?
How do I start Agent Flow?
How do I stop dictation?
How do I talk to my agent?
guides.summary: Tap Top to start Agent Flow and tap again to stop and paste.
narration: Tap Top to start Agent Flow dictation. The light turns red when nothing else is active.
Talk normally. The pointer, HUD and review all keep working while you speak.
Putting the wand down never stops dictation, so tap Top again when you're done. Agent Flow then pastes what you said.

controls.note: Putting the wand down never stops dictation. Use Top to stop and paste.

guides.question: How do I review my changes in VS Code?
questions: How do I use eyes mode?
How do I step through my changes?
How do I go to the next change?
How do I review a diff with the wand?
guides.summary: Choose Review changes, quarter-turn through changes, hold Middle to stage the set.
guides.optionNote: This video shows the default review gestures. With Review with nods and shakes on, use up/down for next and side-to-side for previous instead. Each clear direction change makes one step.
narration: In VS Code, tap Middle to open the HUD. Review changes is just right of Switch App.
Outline it and tap Middle. The HUD hides, the light turns green and review starts.
With no button held, a clockwise quarter-turn goes to the next change. Turn anticlockwise to go back one.
Up to right moves forward one. Right to up moves back one. A full circle moves four changes.
Files you finish join the set. Hold Middle for about half a second to stage them and keep reviewing.
Tap Middle once to cancel and leave review.

controls.note: In VS Code, tap Review changes or Stage files to enter and hide the HUD. Move through a rough quarter-circle or diamond corner: clockwise for one next step, anticlockwise for one previous step, with no button held. A full loop gives four steps; straight up/down flicks are disabled. Tap Middle once to cancel and exit, or hold it for about half a second to stage the working set and keep reviewing. Navigation stays frozen until release. The floating indicator says “(hold to commit set)”. Review changes uses Better Git eyes mode; Stage files uses its whole-file selection.
Review input only runs while VS Code is frontmost. The small review indicator stays above Agent Flow.

guides.question: How do I stage files in VS Code?
questions: How do I use bang mode?
How do I stage a set of files?
How do I commit a set of files?
How do I select whole files to stage?
guides.summary: Choose Stage files, circle to build a set, hold Middle to stage it.
guides.optionNote: This video shows the default review gestures. With Review with nods and shakes on, use up/down for next and side-to-side for previous instead. Each clear direction change makes one step.
narration: In VS Code, open the HUD, outline Stage files next to Review changes, and tap Middle. The light turns purple.
A clockwise quarter-turn moves to the next file. Turn anticlockwise to go back one file.
Each quarter-turn moves one file. Two clockwise quarter-turns move forward two. Reverse to go back one.
Hold Middle for about half a second to stage the whole set. You stay in Stage files, ready for the next one.
Tap Middle once to cancel and leave.

controls.note: In VS Code, tap Review changes or Stage files to enter and hide the HUD. Move through a rough quarter-circle or diamond corner: clockwise for one next step, anticlockwise for one previous step, with no button held. A full loop gives four steps; straight up/down flicks are disabled. Tap Middle once to cancel and exit, or hold it for about half a second to stage the working set and keep reviewing. Navigation stays frozen until release. The floating indicator says “(hold to commit set)”. Review changes uses Better Git eyes mode; Stage files uses its whole-file selection.
Review input only runs while VS Code is frontmost. The small review indicator stays above Agent Flow.

guides.question: How do I play or pause music?
questions: How do I pause a video?
How do I play music?
Where is Play/Pause?
How do I use the media key?
guides.summary: Open the HUD and use Play/Pause, right of Utility on the top row.
narration: Tap Middle to open the HUD. Play/Pause is on the top row, right of Utility.
Turn the wand to outline it, then tap Middle.
It sends your Mac's standard play/pause key, so it controls whatever is playing.

controls.note: The native wand home HUD always has Play/Pause immediately to the right of Utility. It uses the Mac’s standard media key, without changing either physical mouse.
